meanings.usage: 指治疗牙齿疾病的专业医生
指系统地收集某物作为爱好，如收集邮票、硬币、火柴盒等
用于描述两件事同时发生
人体口腔中的器官，用于品尝和说话
指仔细查找某物或某人
指对某事感到不安或焦虑
指将某物从原位置移走或取下
用头部上下运动表示同意、问候或确认
描述不寻常的或让人感到奇怪的事物
指物体上的凹陷或开口处
指停止工作或活动以恢复体力

phrases.usage: /pʊl aʊt/ verb phrase. 拔出；拔掉（指用力将某物从某处拔出，如拔牙、拔刺等）
/ˈkɒtn wʊl/ noun. 棉球；药棉（指用于止血或擦拭的棉花，在牙科中用于塞在拔牙处止血）
/mætʃ bɒks/ noun. 火柴盒（装火柴的小盒子，也是收藏家喜欢收藏的物品）

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻或时间段正在进行的动作 用于描述过去正在发生的动作，常与 when, while 等连用

examples.en: My tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been.
examples.zh: 我的舌头正忙着找出拔掉牙齿的那个洞。

examples.en: It was raining when we left home.
examples.zh: 我们离家时天正在下雨。

examples.en: While I was sleeping, someone stole my car.
examples.zh: 当我睡觉的时候，有人偷了我的车。

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作，即'过去的过去' 用于描述在叙述过去事件时，更早发生的动作

examples.en: The dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth.
examples.zh: 牙医刚刚拔掉了我的一颗牙。

examples.en: I realized I had left my keys at home.
examples.zh: 我意识到我把钥匙落在家里了。

examples.en: She told me she had finished her homework.
examples.zh: 她告诉我她已经完成了作业。

grammar.title: have something done (使役结构)
grammar.structure: 主语 + have + 宾语 + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 让别人做某事或遭遇某种情况 表示主语承受某种动作或经历，常用于医疗、服务等场合

examples.en: The dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth.
examples.zh: 牙医刚刚给我拔了一颗牙。

examples.en: I had my hair cut yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天理发了。

examples.en: She had her bag stolen on the bus.
examples.zh: 她在公交车上被人偷了包。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + have/has + something + 过去分词

original.en: The dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth.
original.zh: 牙医刚刚拔掉了我的一颗牙。

imitations.en: I had my car repaired yesterday.
She had her photo taken at the studio.

patterns.pattern: When/While + 主语 + was/were + doing..., 主语 + did...

original.en: When the dentist at last removed the cotton wool from my mouth, I was able to tell him...
original.zh: 当牙医终于从我嘴里取出棉球时，我能够告诉他...

imitations.en: When I arrived home, it was raining.
imitations.zh: 当我到家时，天正在下雨。

imitations.en: While she was cooking, the phone rang.
imitations.zh: 她做饭的时候，电话响了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn't + 动词原形

original.en: I suddenly felt very worried, but could not say anything.
original.zh: 我突然感到非常担心，但说不出话来。

imitations.en: I couldn't answer the question because it was too difficult.
imitations.zh: 我回答不了这个问题，因为它太难了。

imitations.zh: 她十岁时就能说三种语言。

patterns.pattern: In answer to + 名词/问题, 主语 + 动词...

original.en: In answer to these questions I either nodded or made strange noises.
original.zh: 作为对这些问题的回答，我要么点头，要么发出奇怪的声音。

imitations.en: In answer to your letter, I would like to say thank you.
imitations.zh: 作为对你来信的回复，我想说声谢谢。

imitations.en: In answer to his question, she shook her head.
imitations.zh: 作为对他问题的回答，她摇了摇头。

text.title: Did you want to tell me something?

lines.en: Dentists always ask questions when it is impossible for you to answer.
lines.zh: 牙科医生们总是在你无法作出回答的时候向你提出问题。

lines.en: My dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth and had told me to rest for a while.
lines.zh: 我的牙科医生刚刚给我拔掉了一颗牙，叫我休息一会儿。

lines.en: I tried to say something, but my mouth was full of cotton wool.
lines.zh: 我想说点什么，但我嘴里塞满了药棉。

lines.en: He knew I collected match boxes and asked me whether my collection was growing.
lines.zh: 他知道我收集火柴盒，于是问我收藏的火柴盒是否在增加。

lines.en: He then asked me how my brother was and whether I liked my new job in London.
lines.zh: 接着他又问我的兄弟近来如何，问我是否喜欢伦敦的新工作。

lines.en: In answer to these questions I either nodded or made strange noises.
lines.zh: 作为对这些问题的回答，我不是点头，就是发出奇怪的声音。

lines.en: Meanwhile, my tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been.
lines.zh: 与此同时，我的舌头正在忙着寻找刚拔掉的那颗牙的伤口。

lines.en: I suddenly felt very worried, but could not say anything.
lines.zh: 我突然非常着急起来，但却什么也说不出来。

lines.en: When the dentist at last removed the cotton wool from my mouth, I was able to tell him that he had pulled out the wrong tooth.
lines.zh: 当那位牙医最后将药棉从我嘴中取出时，我总算有可能告诉他，他拔错了牙。

questions.q: Why did the writer become very worried?
questions.zh: 作家为什么变得非常着急？
questions.a: Because his tongue found the hole and he realized the dentist had pulled out the wrong tooth, but with his mouth full of cotton wool he could not say anything.
questions.aZh: 因为他的舌头摸到了那个牙洞，意识到牙医拔错了牙，可嘴里塞满药棉，什么也说不出来。

questions.q: What three questions did the dentist ask after he had pulled out the tooth?
questions.zh: 牙医拔牙后向作家提了哪三个问题？
questions.a: Whether his collection of match boxes was growing; how his brother was; whether he liked his new job in London.
questions.aZh: 火柴盒收藏是否在增加；兄弟近况如何；是否喜欢伦敦的新工作。

questions.q: How did the writer answer the dentist's questions?
questions.zh: 作家是怎样回答牙医这些问题的？
questions.a: In answer to these questions he either nodded or made strange noises.
questions.aZh: 作为对这些问题的回答，他不是点头，就是发出奇怪的声音。

questions.q: Why does 'the hole where the tooth had been' use the past perfect tense?
questions.zh: 为什么 where the tooth had been 要用过去完成时？
questions.a: Because the tooth had already gone before the tongue searched for the hole — an earlier past, 'the past in the past'.
questions.aZh: 因为那颗牙在舌头寻找牙洞之前就已经不在了，属于“过去的过去”。

questions.q: Why does the writer begin with 'Dentists always ask questions when it is impossible for you to answer'?
questions.zh: 作家为什么用“牙医总在你无法回答时提问”开篇？
questions.a: He states the rule first and then acts it out: every question arrives while the mouth is full of cotton wool, so the one thing that really matters — the wrong tooth — cannot be said until the cotton wool is removed.
questions.aZh: 先立规矩、再演实例：所有提问都发生在嘴里塞着药棉之时，最要紧的那句只能等到最后才说出口，正是这种延迟制造了幽默。

translation:
牙科医生们总是在你无法作出回答的时候向你提出问题。
我的牙科医生刚刚给我拔掉了一颗牙，叫我休息一会儿。
我想说点什么，但我嘴里塞满了药棉。
他知道我收集火柴盒，于是问我收藏的火柴盒是否在增加。
接着他又问我的兄弟近来如何，问我是否喜欢伦敦的新工作。
作为对这些问题的回答，我不是点头，就是发出奇怪的声音。
与此同时，我的舌头正在忙着寻找刚拔掉的那颗牙的伤口。
我突然非常着急起来，但却什么也说不出来。
当那位牙医最后将药棉从我嘴中取出时，我总算有可能告诉他，他拔错了牙。
title: Did you want to tell me something?
subtitle: 你想告诉我什么吗？

lead.question: 拔完牙后嘴里塞满药棉，作家为什么突然非常着急？他最后说出了什么？
lead.warmup: 想象你躺在牙科椅上，嘴里塞满药棉，医生却接连发问：火柴盒收藏增加了吗？兄弟好吗？伦敦的新工作喜欢吗？你想回答，却只能点头或发出怪声。本课抓住的正是“无法回答时被提问”的尴尬，结尾一句“您拔错了牙”把笑点引爆。
goals: 复述拔牙就诊的故事脉络，抓住结尾“拔错了牙”这一幽默反转的关键细节
掌握 pull out、cotton wool、collect / collection、nod、meanwhile、search out 等核心词语
熟练运用 either...or、in answer to、be busy doing、be unable to 等本课结构
复习一般过去时、过去完成时、被动语态与情态动词过去式的时间层次
lead.summary: 课文以一句“牙医总在你无法回答时提问”开篇，随后用一连串细节推进：刚拔完牙、嘴里塞着药棉，医生却问火柴盒收藏、兄弟近况和伦敦的新工作。“我”或点头或发出怪声，舌头却忙着探那颗牙留下的洞。直到药棉被取出，“我”才说出真相——他拔错了牙。
lead.tips: where the tooth had been 不是“牙齿曾在某处”，而是“那颗牙原先所在的地方”，牙早已不在，属“过去的过去”，故用 had been。

exercises.q: 语法填空：My dentist had just ______ (pull) out one of my teeth and had told me to rest for a while.
同义改写并填空：when it is impossible for you to answer them → when you ______ ______ ______ answer them; I could ______ say anything.
exercises.note: be unable to；could not 表过去能力。

exercises.q: 汉译英：与此同时，我的舌头正忙着寻找那颗牙原先所在的地方。
exercises.a: Meanwhile, my tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been.

exercises.q: 用 either...or 填空：In answer to these questions I ______ nodded ______ made strange noises.
选词填空（collect / collection / cotton wool / patient / nod）：He knew I ______ match boxes and asked whether my ______ was growing. With ______ in my mouth I could only ______.
用 no sooner...than 改写：The dentist had removed the cotton wool from my mouth. I told him he had pulled out the wrong tooth.
exercises.a: No sooner had the dentist removed the cotton wool from my mouth than I told him he had pulled out the wrong tooth.
exercises.note: no sooner 置句首须倒装。

exercises.q: 改写：The dentist had pulled out the wrong tooth.（改为被动语态）
exercises.a: The wrong tooth had been pulled out (by the dentist).

quiz.q: 拔牙后，作家的嘴里塞满了什么？
牙医知道作家有什么爱好？
作家是怎样“回答”牙医那一连串问题的？
options: He wrote the answers on paper.
He asked the dentist to wait.
He either nodded or made strange noises.

quiz.q: 药棉取出后，作家告诉牙医什么？
options: He had pulled out the wrong tooth.
He had lost his match boxes.
He had to remove the cotton wool.

quiz.q: “my tongue was busy ______ out the hole”中应填入哪种形式？
“where the tooth had been”为什么用过去完成时？
options: The tooth was already gone — 'the past in the past'.
quiz.note: 牙齿已不存在，属“过去的过去”。
